title: What It Really Takes to Build a Startup (Honest Talk) || Founder Interview (noDevBuild)
fulltitle: What It Really Takes to Build a Startup (Honest Talk) || Founder Interview (noDevBuild)
description:
In this video, we had a conversation with Shahrukh Anwar (Founder & CEO of noDevBuild) as part of our leadership project.

He shared his journey, the challenges he faced, and how he built his startup from scratch.

Some key things I learned:
• Execution matters more than theory
• Building the right team is not easy
• You have to keep learning every day
